vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Coordinate participant scheduling and coded sample presentation under an approved study plan.
requirements.zh: 依据获批研究计划协调参与者排程及编码样品呈现。

requirements.en: Maintain separate attendance and questionnaire records with accurate session handovers.
requirements.zh: 分别维护出席及问卷记录，并提供准确活动交接。

requirements.en: Apply controlled procedures and escalate participant or sample concerns appropriately.
requirements.zh: 执行受控程序，并适当升级上报参与者或样品问题。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently design sensory experiments and interpret inferential statistical results.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立设计感官实验，并解释推断统计结果。
